content.thinking: The sed produced `hexOf.hex(...)`. Let me just rewrite that line cleanly with python.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && python3 - <<'PY'
p='codec/CodecTest.java'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("hexOf.hex(bytes)","hexOf(bytes)").replace("hexOf.hex(out)","hexOf(out)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/java/lib/jli:/opt/java/lib:/opt/java/lib/server
/opt/java/bin/javac -proc:none -d codec/classes -cp /workspace/tmp/classes codec/CodecTest.java 2>&1|head -5; /opt/java/bin/java -cp codec/classes:/workspace/tmp/classes CodecTest 2>&1 | tail -10
